Terms of use

Concept website · Updated October 10, 2026

These terms describe this local Orbytechz website and illustrative learning demo. They are not a commercial platform agreement.

Use of this website

You may explore this site and use the sample pathway sketcher for informational purposes. The sketcher displays example learning steps based on preset browser-side rules. It is not connected to an AI model, learning-management system, or learner account.

Learning suggestions

The example pathways are general illustrations, not educational assessments or guarantees of learning outcomes. Educators and learners should use their own judgment to choose resources and adapt instruction to individual needs.

AI and education decisions

The site describes an AI-enabled ecosystem concept. No live AI service evaluates learner data or makes decisions here. Any future AI features should be transparent, appropriately evaluated, accessible, and subject to educator oversight.

Privacy

Do not submit student names, grades, contact details, or other sensitive education information through this demo. Refer to the Privacy notice for details about the prototype.

Future service

Before commercial use, the operator should publish terms matched to the actual product, school or organization responsibilities, data practices, and applicable requirements.
